labs.name: Learning and Adaptive Systems Group
labs.description: Official LAS group page states that Andreas Krause is a Professor of Computer Science at ETH Zurich where he leads the Learning & Adaptive Systems Group. The same official biography states he serves as Chair of the ETH AI Center.
labs.research_summary: Official D-INFK faculty keywords for Andreas Krause: machine learning, artificial intelligence, reinforcement learning, probabilistic inference.

labs.name: Secure, Reliable, and Intelligent Systems Lab
labs.description: Official SRI Lab page states that Martin Vechev is a Full Professor of Computer Science at ETH Zurich where he leads the Secure, Reliable, and Intelligent Systems Lab. Official D-INFK faculty keywords include automated reasoning, machine learning, safe artificial intelligence, and security.
labs.research_summary: Official lab biography describes work at the intersection of artificial intelligence and programming languages, including systems for reliable and safe AI.
